units.translation: ⟦1⟧: ⟦2⟧ in contrast to ⟦3⟧ ⟦4⟧, and the construction as in ⟦5⟧ and the like. If this is correct, then it follows that in the strophe, as at 1034, ⟦6⟧ is to be scanned, and the verse is no longer dactylic, but consists of ⟦7⟧, like ⟦8⟧ ⟦9⟧ (⟦10⟧). Even so, ⟦11⟧ still resists, instead of - ◡ ◡; but ⟦12⟧ can be written (⟦13⟧ 898), since Euripides also scans ⟦14⟧ (Phoen. 1504), as does Aristophanes ⟦15⟧, Kühner-Blass I, 481. ⟦16⟧ (⟦17⟧) ⟦18⟧ of Zeus ⟦19⟧, ⟦20⟧.
the divine heifer from across the sea
⟦1⟧ 'has consented': this meaning is admittedly first attested in Polybius, ⟦2⟧ 3, 10, 1 etc. in connection with ⟦3⟧, on account of which Wieseler also proposes ⟦4⟧ here for the sake of consistency.
